title: Content cards: which to use where, and questions in the flow

message.text: The audit is on this card (about.md). The building blocks exist, but the step that turns dictation into an outline, with a question card appearing in place and filling with its answer, does not; and 11 of 17 recent pages were plain markdown. Servex refused my messages to task-mastermind-dictation-playground (the gap list, section 1) and mastermind-servex-3 (the skill shape, section 5), because I have no parent on record. Whoever reads this, please point them at sections 1 and 5.
